 "rationale": "Each core branch carries Ie(PTAT, UT ln8/R1) plus Veb/R0 (CTAT). R0/R1 cancels the slopes. The mirrored sum flows into R3, giving 0.66 V. Three branches at ~0.28 uA give about 1.6 uW. Long-L devices (Early >~100 V) set line regulation near 10 mV/V and PSRR above 34 dB. Large PNP area keeps VA near 0.6 V, leaving headroom for M2 at VDD 1.6 V. The start-up pulls pb low until ng rises and then idles at nA."}

PARAMS = {
    "Ie":     (0.15e-6, 0.06e-6, 0.4e-6),   # PTAT emitter current per core branch
    "r0k":    (12.5, 8.0, 18.0),            # R0/R1 ratio (sets TC cancellation)
    "kr3":    (1.0, 0.9, 1.1),              # trim on R3 (sets vref)
    "gmid_n": (20.0, 12.0, 25.0),
    "L_n":    (4.0, 1.0, 10.0),
    "gmid_p": (14.0, 8.0, 16.0),
    "L_p":    (6.0, 2.0, 12.0),
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    VDD = 1.8
    N = 8                      # Q2:Q1 area ratio
    MQ1 = 8                    # Q1 multiplicity (large area -> lower Veb -> headroom)
    Ie = p["Ie"]
    dV = UT * math.log(N)
    R1 = dV / Ie
    # Veb model: 0.76 V at 10 uA per unit device, Vg0_eff ~1.27 V
    Veb = 0.76 + UT * math.log((Ie / MQ1) / 10e-6)
    dVeb_dT = -(1.27 - Veb) / 300.0
    R0 = p["r0k"] * R1
    Ir0 = Veb / R0
    I = Ie + Ir0               # current in each core branch and in the output branch
    vref_t = 0.66
    R3 = p["kr3"] * vref_t / I

    # devices
    mn = lut.size("n", p["gmid_n"], p["L_n"], I, vds=0.6, vsb=Veb)
    mp = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["L_p"], I, vds=0.8)

    n = Netlist("vdd vref vss")
    # core
    n.dev("M3", "ng", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.dev("M1", "ng", "ng", "va", "vss", mn)
    n.Q("Q1", "vss", "vss", "va", m=MQ1)
    n.R("R0A", "va", "vss", R0)
    n.dev("M4", "pb", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.dev("M2", "pb", "ng", "vb", "vss", mn)
    n.R("R1", "vb", "qb", R1)
    n.Q("Q2", "vss", "vss", "qb", m=MQ1 * N)
    n.R("R0B", "vb", "vss", R0)
    n.C("CPB", "vdd", "pb", 1e-12)
    # output branch
    n.dev("M5", "vref", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.R("R3", "vref", "vss", R3)
    # start-up: weak pull-up (gated by vref) on sg; sg pulls pb low; Ms3 kills it once ng is up
    n.M("MSP1", "sx", "vref", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", 0.42, 20)
    n.M("MSP2", "sg", "vref", "sx", "vdd", "pfet", 0.42, 20)
    n.M("MS3", "sg", "ng", "vss", "vss", "nfet", 0.42, 1.0)
    n.M("MS1", "pb", "sg", "vss", "vss", "nfet", 0.42, 1.0)

    # predictions
    vref = R3 * I
    dI_dT = (dV / 300.0) / R1 + dVeb_dT / R0
    tc_lin = abs(R3 * dI_dT) / vref * 1e6
    tc_ppm = tc_lin + 150.0          # Veb curvature allowance
    # line regulation: output Early effect plus core offset from M2/M3 Vds changes
    lam_p = mp.gds / I
    lam_n = mn.gds / I
    gmid_n = mn.gm / I
    off = (lam_n + lam_p) / gmid_n   # V offset per V of VDD
    ptat_frac = (Ie * R3) / vref
    line = vref * lam_p + vref * ptat_frac * off / dV
    psrr = -db(max(line, 1e-6))
    power = VDD * (3 * I + 0.02e-6)
    return n, {"vref": vref, "tc_ppm": tc_ppm, "line_reg": line,
               "power": power, "psrr_1k": psrr, "startup_ok": 1}
